metadata.title: Wedbush Revises Best Ideas List After October Underperformance

content.text:
Investing.com -- Wedbush updated its Best Ideas List after a challenging October, in which the portfolio returned -11.6%, versus -0.9% for the S&P 500, -5.3% for the Nasdaq and +0.5% for the Russell 2000.
The broker removed Reddit and Arcus Biosciences for investment price discipline. It uses an automatic sale rule if a stock falls 25% relative to the average move of the S&P 500 and Russell 2000. All names are rated Outperform.
Prices below are as of the Oct. 30 close.
-
Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) - $278.99, target $387, implying about 39% upside.
-
IMAX Corporation (IMAX) - $49.80, target $60, about 21% upside.
-
Take-Two Interactive Software Inc. (TTWO) - $192.10, target $280, about 46% upside.
-
Silicon Motion Technology Corporation (SIMO) - $187.90, target $400, about 113% upside.
-
Western Digital Corporation (WDC) - $338.59, target $650, about 92% upside.
-
Palo Alto Networks Inc. (PANW) - $351.72, target $400, about 14% upside.
-
Rubrik Inc. (RBRK) - $114.67, target $150, about 31% upside.
-
Willdan Group Inc. (WLDN) - $72.02, target $130, about 81% upside.
-
Scholar Rock Holding Corporation (SRRK) - $42.91, target $70, about 63% upside.
-
Tyra Biosciences Inc. (TYRA) - $21.33, target $53, about 149% upside.
-
Climb Bio, Inc. (CLYM) - $9.74, target $25, about 157% upside.
-
Zenas BioPharma, Inc. (ZBIO) - $27.62, target $45, about 63% upside.
